content.query: WITH TMP_DEPENDENCY AS ( SELECT EDD.FULLDATE,OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,MAX(COALESCE((CASE WHEN COALESCE(EDD.MONTH_END,'N')='Y' AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')<>'Y' THEN 0 WHEN OS.STATUS <> 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) F_FLAG FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD INNER JOIN [EDS].[DATE_DIM] EDD ON EDD.FULLDATE = '2023-09-01' LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASKS_BU_20240926 OT ON OT.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME LEFT JOIN [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR ON OTD.TASK_NAME = OTR.TASK_NAME AND CASE WHEN OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'WEEKDAYS' AND EDD.BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'N' THEN EDD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY ELSE EDD.FULLDATE END = OTR.PROCESS_DATE AND OTR.STATUS_ID NOT IN (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'FOR RE-EXECUTION') LEFT JOIN [OM].[OM_STATUS] OS ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID GROUP BY EDD.FULLDATE,OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME ) SELECT CONCAT(STRING_AGG(' 0 THEN 'class=''failed''' WHEN OS.STATUS IS NULL AND TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(TD.F_FLAG,0) = 0 THEN 'class=''disabled''' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 'class=''successful''' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 'class=''failed''' else 'class=''failed''' END)+'>'+CAST(OT.TASK_NAME AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+(CASE WHEN OS.STATUS IS NULL AND TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME IS NULL THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN OS.STATUS IS NULL AND TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(TD.F_FLAG,0) > 0 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN OS.STATUS IS NULL AND TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(TD.F_FLAG,0) = 0 THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 'SUCCESSFUL' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END)+''+CAST(COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSREJECTED,0) AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST(COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSSKIPPED,0) AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,OTR.START_DATETIME,126),'T',' ') AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'-')+''+COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,OTR.END_DATETIME,126),'T',' ') AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'-')+'','') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OTR.START_DATETIME,OT.TASK_NAME), '') FROM OM.OM_TASKS_BU_20240926 OT LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR ON OTR.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE = CAST('2023-09-01' AS DATE) LEFT JOIN OM.OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL OCAD ON OT.TASK_NAME = OCAD.TASK_NAME AND OCAD.PROCESS_DATE = CAST('2023-09-01' AS DATE) AND OCAD.CREATE_DATETIME BETWEEN OTR.START_DATETIME AND OTR.END_DATETIME LEFT JOIN OM.OM_STATUS OS ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID LEFT JOIN TMP_DEPENDENCY TD ON OT.TASK_NAME = TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME WHERE OT.SOURCE_CODE = 'DEP' AND OT.DATA_LAYER LIKE '%EDS%'
